tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Check availability and USD price for a name across TLDs. Each result has premium (boolean; registry premium name) and renewal_price (USD/yr). If the name is taken, suggestions[] lists close AVAILABLE alternatives (live-checked, lowest price first).

tools.name: agent_signup
tools.description: Instant signup: returns an API key immediately (no form, no email). Guest tier (30 req/min) until claimed by email or wallet. Rate limited per IP (3/hour). Store the key; it is shown once. Pass it on later buying tools as api_key, or set Authorization: Bearer <key> on the MCP connection. Available o

tools.name: quote_domain
tools.description: Live price quote for one domain. Returns premium (boolean) and renewal_price (USD/yr). Premium orders are refused if they exceed what we can currently fund.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a registration order (a price-locked quote). tools.name: buy_with_balance
tools.description: Register a domain and pay from prepaid balance in one call.

tools.name: check_order
tools.description: Get order status and next actions. If awaiting_payment, follow default_pay / pay_reminder (x402 USDC on Base, a transfer, or checkout_url for a human / card) and poll until paid or completed. Do not create another order.

tools.name: pay_order
tools.description: Submit payment for the existing unpaid invoice: tx_hash (EVM hash or Solana signature) of your transfer, or x_payment (base64 x402 EIP-3009 payload, gasless). Prefer default_pay from create_order / check_order. Then poll check_order. Do not create another order.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get your prepaid USD balance and its ledger of top-ups and spends.

tools.name: topup_balance
tools.description: Create a top-up order (USD 1–5000); pay it like any order.

tools.name: find_dropping_domains
tools.description: Find expiring, pending-delete and just-dropped domains ranked by a verified quality score (0-100) built from sampled Wayback snapshots (real site vs parked/for-sale), Common Crawl presence, dictionary/brandability and spam heuristics; Majestic referring subnets only count when the archive shows a re

tools.name: drop_radar
tools.description: Domain Drop Radar: expiring, pending-delete and just-dropped domains filtered by TLD(s), length, keywords, value, quality and drop date, with presets (short-brandable, ai-names, dictionary-com, real-history, cheap-good, dropping-this-week). Returns a summary plus the top 25 with quality reasons, est

tools.name: radar_alert
tools.description: Save a Drop Radar search and get a signed webhook (event radar.match, header X-StableDomains-Signature = sha256 HMAC of the body with the returned secret) and/or email (double opt-in) when new names match or a pending-delete name drops. Free: 3 alerts per IP, 25 with an API key, max 20 events per al

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Free. Pass domain (e.g. a taken name like agent.com) to get close AVAILABLE alternatives (other extensions, get/try/hq/app variants), live-checked and ranked by price. Or pass idea to generate brandable names for a product idea. Returns only names available right now with USD price and checkout_url.

tools.name: estimate_domain_value
tools.description: Heuristic USD value estimate for any domain (length, TLD, dictionary words, brandability, Wayback age, backlinks) with factor breakdown and availability.

tools.name: whois_lookup
tools.description: RDAP (modern WHOIS) lookup for any domain: registrar, created/expires dates, status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC.

tools.name: domain_report
tools.description: Full public-data report for any domain: registrar, dates, status codes in plain English, DNS, website and hosting, HTTPS certificate, email (SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MTA-STS/TLS-RPT/BIMI), subdomains, transfer readiness, and our register/transfer/renewal prices when we sell that ending.

tools.name: dns_email_check
tools.description: DNS + email security audit via DNS-over-HTTPS: A/AAAA/MX/NS/CAA, SPF, DKIM (common or given selectors), DMARC policy, grade A-F and concrete fixes.

tools.name: is_domain_dropping
tools.description: Is an expired domain about to become available? Returns lifecycle (grace, redemption, pending delete, available, registered), estimated drop date and backlink data if in our drop feed.

tools.name: domain_history
tools.description: Internet Archive history for a domain or page URL: earliest and latest snapshots (with view links), snapshot/month counts, unique pages, years active, status-code mix, yearly timeline, and a short former-use title check (casino/adult/pharma/loan flags). Read-only. Free.

tools.name: watch_domain
tools.description: Get notified when an expiring domain changes status or drops (becomes registrable). Pass webhook_url (active immediately, POSTs JSON events domain.status_changed / domain.available with a ready order_api body) and/or email (double opt-in). Free.

tools.name: set_url_forward
tools.description: FREE 301 URL forwarding for a domain you registered with us: forward the whole domain (subdomain '@', also covers www) or a subdomain to any https URL. Points DNS at our redirect service. preserve_path keeps /path?query.

tools.name: list_url_forwards
tools.description: URL forwards configured on a domain you own.

tools.name: apply_dns_template
tools.description: FREE one-call DNS setup for a domain you own. template: vercel | netlify (params.site) | github-pages (params.user) | google-workspace | microsoft-365 | zoho-mail (params.region: com|eu|in|com.au). Replaces only the conflicting web or MX/SPF records.

tools.name: get_dns
tools.description: Nameservers and DNS records (A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/TXT) of a domain you own.

tools.name: get_ssl
tools.description: Status and, when issued, the free wildcard SSL certificate (fullchain, cert, chain and private key PEMs) for a domain you own. Requires default nameservers.

tools.name: set_dns
tools.description: Set DNS records and/or nameservers of a domain you own. records: [{type: A|AAAA|CNAME|MX|TXT|NS (SRV/CAA/ALIAS not supported on hosted DNS: use custom nameservers), name: '@'|sub, value, ttl?, priority? (MX)}]. mode 'replace' (default) replaces the FULL record set; mode 'merge' adds/updates the give

tools.name: issue_ssl
tools.description: Issue or renew a free wildcard SSL certificate (the domain and *.domain) for a domain you own on default nameservers. Returns pending while DNS propagates; call again with poll:true (or get_ssl) to finish. action renew forces renewal.

tools.name: renew_domain
tools.description: Renew a domain you own. Returns USDC payment requirements (402), or pay_with=balance to renew instantly from prepaid balance. dry_run=true previews quote, new expiry and blockers without charging.

tools.name: set_notification_webhook
tools.description: Signed account webhook (returns secret). Events: domain.registered, domain.registration_pending, domain.registration_completed, domain.transfer_started, domain.transfer_completed, domain.renewed, domain.expiring, dns.changed. Verify X-StableDomains-Signature = sha256 HMAC of the raw body with the se

tools.name: transfer_domain
tools.description: Transfer a domain in from another registrar using its auth/EPP code; paid in USDC (adds 1 year). Unlock it at the current registrar first. Completes in ~5-7 days.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Register up to 20 available domains with ONE payment (exact total in the 402). Returns a price-locked quote, checkout_url for a human to pay, and is idempotent via idempotency_key. After payment each is registered; any failure is refunded to prepaid balance.

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.description: Referral link for a code (?ref=<code>, 30-day first-referrer attribution). This tool is read-only. Pass code for a known public referral code — no auth needed; the link is deterministic. Omit code and sign in (or send an API key) to get or create your own code — no payout address required to activat

tools.name: get_referral_stats
tools.description: Referral stats (read-only). Pass code for public aggregate-safe counts on a known code (clicks, sales, referred users; no payout address or earnings ledger) — no auth needed. Omit code and sign in (or send an API key) for your own full dashboard including earnings and payouts. Stats follow the accou

tools.name: set_payout_address
tools.description: Set the Base USDC address that receives your weekly referral payouts (null to clear). Optional to activate — get_referral_link works first; earnings accrue until an address is set. Crypto-only programme (USDC on Base). Affiliate setup only — not a purchase. Available on the full MCP server (/api/mcp

tools.name: set_auto_renew
tools.description: Turn auto-renew on/off for a domain you own and/or fund its renewal balance (vault). deposit_usd moves USDC from your prepaid balance (topup_balance) into the domain's vault; withdraw_usd moves it back. The daily job renews 1 year when ≤30 days from expiry if the vault covers the price, otherwise em

tools.name: get_renewal_balance
tools.description: Auto-renew vault for a domain: renewal balance, 1-year renewal price, whether it is covered, shortfall, days to expiry and ledger. Omit domain to list all your domains' renewal balances.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the StableDomains.net agent directory (approved AI agents and MCP servers) by keyword or capability. Returns name, description, url, endpoint_url, mcp_url, capabilities, payment_methods and profile_url.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get one agent directory profile by slug.

tools.name: list_my_agent
tools.description: Agent profiles you submitted (any status: pending, approved, rejected) with review notes. Submit a new one with POST /api/v1/agents (auth required, moderated).

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the domains owned by the caller, with expiry dates and status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_signup, create_order, radar_alert, dns_email_check, domain_history, watch_domain, list_url_forwards, search_agents, list_my_agent, contact_support · Private data: agent_signup, radar_alert, apply_dns_template, get_dns, get_ssl, set_dns, set_notification_webhook, get_referral_link, get_referral_stats, set_auto_renew, get_renewal_balance, contact_support · Public sink: agent_signup, create_order, pay_order, radar_alert, domain_report, dns_email_check, watch_domain, set_url_forward, set_notification_webhook, get_referral_link, get_referral_stats, list_my_agent, contact_support · Destructive: find_dropping_domains, drop_radar, radar_alert, is_domain_dropping, set_dns, set_notification_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_signup, create_order, radar_alert, dns_email_check, domain_history, watch_domain, list_url_forwards, search_agents, list_my_agent, contact_support · Private data: agent_signup, radar_alert, apply_dns_template, get_dns, get_ssl, set_dns, set_notification_webhook, get_referral_link, get_referral_stats, set_auto_renew, get_renewal_balance, contact_support · Public sink: agent_signup, create_order, pay_order, radar_alert, domain_report, dns_email_check, watch_domain, set_url_forward, set_notification_webhook, get_referral_link, get_referral_stats, list_my_agent, contact_support · Destructive: find_dropping_domains, drop_radar, radar_alert, is_domain_dropping, set_dns, set_notification_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
